title: get_ecosystem input

workspace.description: The workspace whose members and links to report (A29).

link_file_id.description: Pin a sealed link file; default is the latest sealed for the workspace.

envelope.description: compact leaves out the snapshot-wide parts of the envelope (unresolved reasons, standing limitations) that an earlier answer from the same snapshot already gave; query-specific limits stay. Over MCP, answers after the first full one per snapshot are compact unless full is asked for.

description: The ecosystem overview of a workspace (A11): its repositories as nodes with their member snapshots, the cross-repository links between them by type with match confidence, and the client facts that matched nothing, as unresolved boundaries. Answers from the workspace's sealed link file; run `proofmesh workspace link <name>` to build one.
